Coverage backstop and pull-request dispatcher (#3039 H6b). The ratchet job runs the whole tests/ suite on every pull request and push to main with no path filter; the consolidated-source-validators job runs the non-tests/ validators retired from 16 per-feature workflows. The other stable dispatchers are workflow_dispatch only, so moving pull-request gates into them would have removed the gate. Validation only; no runtime authority.

invariant: Every repository-authored workflow file must be explicitly registered before merge/push. Unregistered workflow proliferation fails closed; registration is classification evidence, not approval to retain the workflow permanently.
completion_condition: Every registered surface is KEEP_STABLE_DISPATCHER, KEEP_STANDALONE_EXCEPTION with evidence, CONSOLIDATE_INTO_STABLE_DISPATCHER, TRANSFER_TO_STEGVERSE_WORKER, ELIMINATE, or terminally removed; REVIEW_REQUIRED/BLOCKED states are zero unless supported by active ownership.
